card.name: Study follow-up and trial duration wording
card.fires_on: Words in clinical trial descriptions that lead into how long patients were followed or studied, such as 'observed', 'for', 'to' and 'studies' before a time span.

modes.label: Observed for a period
modes.description: The word 'observed' or 'for' after patients are followed after a trial ends or for an outcome.
modes.example: After completion of the trial, a large subset of patients was<< observed>> for up to 10 additional years

modes.label: Study words and durations
modes.description: 'study' or 'studies' after 'clinical' or 'longer-term', or 'to' in 'for up to' a number of days.
modes.example: In a longer-term<< study>>, paliperidone extended-release tablets

card.writes: It may nudge the model toward words about experiments, trials and spans of time, though the listed tokens are mixed.
card.plain: It fires on wording that says how long patients were followed or studied in a trial.
